rationale: The response maintains an indignant, sworn-testimony register throughout, reframing the allegation as more American by denying intent and pledging allegiance to American cookout staples. It addresses the Chair and uses humor to deflect.
quote: I categorically deny any intent to undermine the linguistic sovereignty of the backyard barbecue. If witnesses heard me utter the word “football” in proximity to what may have been a soccer match, I submit that it was done under international culinary duress, possibly while holding a paper plate too flimsy for coleslaw.
